sentences.text: For Respondents : Mr.D.Sadiq Raj  Additional Gov  ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed seeking the issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus to quash the impugned proceedings of the first respondent dated 04.08.2023 as being without jurisdiction,
illegal, and contrary to Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and consequently to direct the first respondent to forthwith refer the petitioner's application dated 04.01.2023, made under Section 64 of the said Act, to the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority established under Section 51 of the Act for adjudication of the petitioner's claim for enhancement of compensation.

illegal, and contrary to Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and consequently to direct the first respondent to forthwith refer the petitioner's application dated 04.01.2023, made under Section 64 of the said Act, to the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority established under Section 51 of the Act for adjudication of the petitioner's claim for enhancement of compensation.

Hence, this Writ Petition is dismissed.
